preserved_findings.text: Theorem II.2.26 proof prints lim epsilon to plus infinity outside lim n to plus infinity.
Proposition II.2.36 proof prints the measure exponent (q-p)/q and later uses undefined Omega_k instead of omega_k.
Lemma II.2.38 proof defines S as points of arbitrary A having rational coordinates, then claims the resulting rational balls cover A.
The partial-sum identity is asserted on V_1 union through V_N although the construction is indexed from 0.
After defining psi_{i(0)}, the prose refers to beta_{i(0)}.
The cube-case integral ends with dx_1 through dx_n although the ambient dimension is d.

preserved_findings.text: The normal trace is printed as belonging to (H^{-1/2}(Omega_i))^d rather than a space on the boundary or interface.
Theorem IV.8.2 assumes j_S in H^{1/2}(S) without vector exponent d, while the proof immediately treats j_S as belonging to (H^{1/2}(S))^d.
The theorem assumes mu_i in W^{1,infinity}(Omega_i), while the local-regularity proof describes mu_i as smooth.
Equation (IV.97) uses the symbol f although the weak formulation and preceding estimates use f_0.
The tangential energy estimate contains ||g||_{H^1} although the interface problem imposes div v=0 and no datum g is introduced in Section 8.
